title: A naturalist's dawn birding routine
storyboard: Film: naturalist at first light lacing boots, scanning with binoculars, writing in a field notebook (POV)
caption:
My morning routine, but make it birds.

The same Western Ghats study found little support for the old idea that birds sing at dawn simply because sound carries better then.

Source: Cornell Lab of Ornithology. Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
